title: 第19章 舒服吗第20章 儒首孔丘
content_zh:
;;
“让姐姐检查一下，是不是真长大了。”
房间内，看到眼前小公子拘束的模样，红烛更加胆大了，上前一步，伸手就要脱前者衣衫。
“这……不好吧。”
李子夜退后两步，一脸为难道。
“有什么不好的，小时候又不是没看过。”
红烛脸上笑容越发明媚，说道。
“那时候还小，不懂。”
李子夜脸上露出腼腆之色，说道。
“现在大了吗？”
红烛伸出手，抚摸着前者胸膛，并且不断朝着下面滑去。
“现……现在？”
李子夜身子一个激灵，再度向后退去。
然而，再退，后面便是床。
“哎哟。”
李子夜没有站稳，一下子向后倒去，倒的时候，下意识抓向身前的女子。
“啊！”
红烛一声惊呼，身子也跟着倒了下去。
于是，两人的身子便叠在了一起。
近在咫尺，软玉温香，李子夜嘴角，弯起一抹得逞的笑容。

“舒服吗？”
红烛开口，轻声道。
“舒服。”
李子夜应了一句，突然觉得不对，双手下意识握了握，顿时，一股柔软的触感传来。
卧槽！
李子夜不喜反惊，头上冷汗立刻流下。
“啊！”
下一刻，房间内，一道凄惨的痛呼声响起，吓得外面的李府下人们全都不敢说话了。
公子又怎么了？
秦仙子明明还在这里啊！
湖边，秦婀娜、张邋遢嘴角全都一弯，显然很是解气。
活该！
“红……红烛姐，我不是故意的。”
房间内，李子夜蜷缩在地上，疼的腰都直不起来，断断续续地说道。
“我是故意的。”
红烛攥了攥纤细的右手，眸中闪过危险的笑容，道，“小子夜，是真长大了。”
content_en:

"Let my sister check to see if she has really grown up."
In the room, seeing the restrained look of the young master in front of her, Hongzhu became even bolder. She took a step forward and reached out to take off the former's clothes.
"This...isn't good."
Li Ziye took two steps back, looking confused.
"What's wrong? It's not like I never saw it when I was a kid."
The smile on Hongzhu's face became brighter and brighter, and she said.
"I was still young and didn't understand."
Li Ziye said with a shy look on his face.
"Are you older now?"
Hongzhu stretched out her hand, caressed the former's chest, and kept sliding downwards.
"Now...now?"
Li Ziye trembled and stepped back again.
However, if you step back further, there is a bed behind you.
"Ouch."
Li Ziye didn't stand firm and fell backwards. When he fell, he subconsciously grabbed the woman in front of him.
"Ah!"
Hongzhu exclaimed and fell down.
As a result, the two bodies were stacked on top of each other.
So close, the soft jade smelled warm, and the corners of Li Ziye's mouth curved into a smile of success.
"Are you comfortable?"
Hongzhu spoke softly.
"Comfortable."
Li Ziye responded, but suddenly felt something was wrong, and subconsciously clasped his hands, feeling a soft touch.
Damn it!
Li Ziye was not happy but was shocked, and cold sweat immediately started flowing down his head.
"Ah!"
The next moment, a miserable cry of pain rang out in the room, frightening the people outside the Li Mansion to the point where they did not dare to speak.
What happened to the young master?
Fairy Qin is obviously still here!
By the lake, Qin Grace and Zhang Sloppy's mouths all curled up, obviously very relieved.
Deserve it!
"Hong...Sister Hongzhu, I didn't mean it."
In the room, Li Ziye huddled on the ground, unable to straighten up because of the pain, and spoke intermittently.
"I did it on purpose."
Hongzhu clenched her slender right hand, a dangerous smile flashed in her eyes, and said, "Xiao Ziye, you have really grown up."
